SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO AS V_INVOICE_NO FROM KEPCMCL01 CL01 , VW_ERP_SLS_CMCL01 CC01 WHERE 1=1 AND CL01.ERP_SND_STATE_CD = 'N' AND (CL01.MILE_CHK = 'N' OR CL01.MILE_CHK IS NULL) AND CL01.BILL_CNFRM_CHK = 'Y' AND (( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK='Y' AND CL01.ATTR_1='Y') OR ( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK IS NULL ) OR ( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK = 'N' ) ) AND CL01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = CC01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO AS V_INVOICE_NO , DECODE( GETALANCINFO(CL01.CMPNY_ALANC_ID,'BIZMN_REGST_NO') , '1078185880', 'SE' /* 서울본사 */ , '1138523209', 'GU' /* 구로 */ , '6158508913', 'CW' /* 창원 */ , ' ' ) AS V_SAUPJ , CC01.ERP_DEPT_CD AS V_DEPARTCODE , CL01.TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_DATE AS V_INVOICE_DATE , REPLACE(CL01.BIZMN_REGST_NO,'-','') AS V_CUSTOMER , '' AS V_CUSTOMER_PONO , CL01.PAY_CND_CD AS V_PAYMENT_TERM , '' AS V_WHOUT_NO , 'B01' AS V_WHOUT_TYPE , NVL (( /*+INDEX DESC (MPCL02 KEPMPCL02_PK)*/ SELECT MPCL02.CURR_CD FROM KEPMPCL02 MPCL02 WHERE MPCL02.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO AND MPCL02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ),'KRW') AS V_CURRENCY , NVL (( /*+INDEX DESC (MPCL02 KEPMPCL02_PK)*/ SELECT DECODE(MPCL02.CURR_CD,'KRW',0, MPCL02.EXRATE) FROM KEPMPCL02 MPCL02 /*매출마감대상*/ WHERE MPCL02.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO AND MPCL02.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ),0) AS V_IEX_RATE , NVL (( SELECT SUM(DECODE(MPCL02.CURR_CD,'KRW',0, MPCL02.WON_CNVRS_SLS_AMT)) FROM KEPMPCL02 MPCL02 /*매출마감대상*/ WHERE MPCL02.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO AND MPCL02.USE_CHK = 'Y' ),0) AS V_DAMOUNT , 0 AS V_TOT_DAMOUNT , NVL(CC01.SLS_AMT,0) AS V_AMOUNT , NVL(CL01.TOT_SLS_AMT,0) AS V_TOT_AMOUNT , NVL(CC01.ADJUSTED_SLS_VAT,0) AS V_TAX_AMOUNT , NVL(CC01.SLS_VAT,0) AS V_TOT_TAX_AMOUNT , CL01.TAX_CLSS_CD AS V_TAX_CODE , 1 AS V_TAX_COUNT , ( SELECT T.GDS_NM FROM KEPCMCL02 T WHERE T.TAX_BILL_NO = CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO AND T.PRCHS_SLS_CLSS_CD='SA' AND ROWNUM=1 ) AS V_REMARK , CL01.RESGTR_ID AS V_CREATE_EMPNO , CL01.FRST_REGST_DATM AS V_CREATE_DATE , 'N' AS V_CANCEL_FLAG , '' AS V_CANCEL_DATE , 'N' AS V_CLOSE_FLAG , CL01.RESGTR_ID AS V_INTERFACE_EMPNO, CL01.FRST_REGST_DATM AS V_INTERFACE_DATE , ' ' AS V_INTERFACE_FLAG , DECODE(CL01.ALANC_CLSS_CD,'C001','KA','C002','SA','C003','KW','') AS V_ATTRIBUTE1 , '상품매출' AS V_ATTRIBUTE3 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE4 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE5 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE6 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE7 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE8 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE9 , '' AS V_ATTRIBUTE10 ,/*스마트빌 세금계산서번호*/ DECODE(CL01.TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_SITE_CD,'02','Y','N') AS V_TRANSFER_FLAG FROM KEPCMCL01 CL01 , VW_ERP_SLS_CMCL01 CC01 WHERE 1=1 AND CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.V_INVOICE_NO$' AND CL01.ERP_SND_STATE_CD = 'N' AND (CL01.MILE_CHK = 'N' OR CL01.MILE_CHK IS NULL) AND CL01.BILL_CNFRM_CHK = 'Y' AND (( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK='Y' AND CL01.ATTR_1='Y') OR ( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK IS NULL ) OR ( CL01.ELCTR_TAX_BILL_PBLCTN_CHK = 'N' ) ) AND CL01.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND CL01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = CC01.SLS_TAX_BILL_NO
UPDATE KEPCMCL01 SET ERP_SND_STATE_CD = 'Y', ERP_SND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), LST_MDFY_DATM = SYSDATE, MDFYR_ID = 'FTP' WHERE ERP_SND_STATE_CD = 'N' AND SLS_TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.V_INVOICE_NO$' AND USE_CHK = 'Y'
